context.what-this-is: This is a crate called 'enforcer' that enforces structural rules on a Rust codebase. The enforcer reports any violations of rules. We are running it on this codebase itself, but also of course intend to use it on other codebases.
context.notes: - Config params are read from `enforcer.toml` in the project root. These change how the rules behave. - There is a --fix option to apply automated fixes for some rules. - There is a --report option to generate reports related to a rule for some rules. - There is a --help option to describe all information about a given rule.
context.tests: There is no test suite at the moment. Don't add tests unless asked.
